entries.camera: Backlit silhouette shot from deep inside a dark arena tunnel, eye level, perfectly centred one-point perspective, the figure about a third of the frame height.
entries.subject: A lone champion in battered, polished plate armour and a closed helm, seen from behind and in near-silhouette, standing at the mouth of an arena tunnel with a greatsword resting point-down in front of the boots, both gauntlets on the pommel. Beyond, a vast arena of raked sand blazes in blinding sunlight, its crowded stone tiers reduced to a blurred haze with plain unmarked pennants. Dust motes drift in the light beams and the champion's armour edges glow like a fine gold line.

entries.camera: Straight-down overhead view of a table, symmetrical, wide lens, a pool of lantern light in the centre and the darkest edge of the table at the bottom of the frame.
entries.subject: A heavy oak war table seen from directly above, covered by a hand-painted map of rivers, forests and mountain passes with no writing on it at all. Carved wooden figures of knights, archers and siege towers stand across the terrain, and a taut red thread runs around a hill to show a flanking move. A leather-gloved hand, cropped at the wrist, slides a carved cavalry piece forward. Beside it lie a few eight-sided bone dice with blank notched faces and two guttering candles.
entries.accent: sealing-wax crimson with warm parchment tan

entries.camera: Tight close-up at hand height, 85mm, very shallow depth of field, a high shutter speed freezing the motion, the lens just beside the gauntlet.
entries.subject: A longsword flies point-first through the air and slaps into an open steel gauntlet, called back to the hand the instant the fingers close around the grip. A long ribbon of crackling arcane lightning trails behind the blade, and a small spell circle made of abstract, non-legible glyph shapes flares open in the air beside it. Only the plate vambrace and gauntlet are visible, cropped at the elbow. Behind, a blurred wall of weapons on a dark armoury rack.
entries.accent: electric cobalt-blue arcs with white sparks

entries.camera: Canted (dutch-angle) wide shot at about waist height, 28mm, the horizon tilted roughly twenty degrees, frozen mid-motion.
entries.subject: In a moonlit ruined hall, a knight in full armour stands still in silhouette, seen from behind, hands lowered. Ten paces ahead a translucent, ghostly copy of the same armoured figure, trailing a faint echo of afterimages, swings a greatsword down and splits a huge fallen column in two, stone chips hanging in the air. The real knight has not moved. Pale mist hangs low and cold light slants through the broken roof.
entries.accent: cold moon-silver and ice-white with a faint ghostly teal edge

entries.camera: Over-the-shoulder view from behind and slightly above the archer's hood, long lens, focus pulled to the bow hand and the glowing arrow.
entries.subject: A hooded archer seen from behind in a mossy forest ruin, a longbow just released. The arrow burns with a spiralling magical glow and streaks away in a curve, bending around a tall stone column instead of flying straight, its light painting a long arc through the mist. At the far end of the arc a hanging iron target ring glows where it is about to land. The bowstring still trembles and sparks drift from the fingers.

entries.camera: Low-angle shot from the floor of a hall looking steeply up, wide lens, strong foreshortening, frozen at a high shutter speed.
entries.subject: In a collapsing stone hall, a fighter in light half-plate stands seen from behind and below, one open hand raised. Above, a cloud of huge falling ceiling blocks and a loose sword hang suspended in mid-air, held motionless by invisible force, with a faceted translucent honeycomb of energy flickering around the hand. Dust and small stones drift upward, ignoring gravity. Beams of daylight fall through the broken vault into the darkness.

entries.camera: Extreme wide high-angle shot from a mountain ridge looking down into a snowy valley, deep atmospheric perspective.
entries.subject: A fighter in heavy plate grown to the size of a tower, seen from behind, wades knee-deep through a snow-laden pine forest in a mountain valley, a vast round shield on one arm. The pines reach only to its ankles. Glowing carved glyphs, abstract shapes that cannot be read as writing, run across the breastplate, the shield and the greaves, throwing their orange light across the drifts. Low clouds wrap the peaks and snow spills from the branches.
entries.accent: glowing ember-orange glyphs on cold slate-grey and snow-white

entries.camera: Side-on horizontal macro close-up at blade level, razor-thin depth of field, the curved blade in sharp focus running across the frame.
entries.subject: The edge of a slender, single-edged curved blade, held perfectly steady, has just cut a falling cherry blossom petal cleanly in two; the halves drift apart on either side of the steel. A faint flame-shaped glow of fighting spirit clings to the edge. Hands cropped at the wrist, gripping a cord-wrapped hilt. Behind, blurred by the lens, a kneeling figure in lacquered lamellar armour with its back to the viewer, in a garden of drifting petals at dawn.
entries.accent: dawn peach-pink with ink-black and a thin vermilion glow

entries.camera: Ground-level wide shot from behind the horse's hooves, 24mm, looking along a narrow bridge toward the far bank, rain streaks catching the light.
entries.subject: A knight in full plate and closed helm sits a barded warhorse at the centre of a narrow stone bridge, seen from behind, tower shield raised on one arm and a lance held upright with a plain unmarked pennant snapping in the wind. The horse stands planted, hooves splashing in a shallow flood of rainwater, refusing to give an inch. Ahead, storm-dark hills and the far bank are lit by a single break in the clouds.
entries.accent: dusty russet and storm-grey with a pale rain-light

entries.camera: Symmetrical eye-level wide shot, anamorphic look, the standard dead centre of the frame, lens flare along its edge.
entries.subject: A huge royal standard of plain purple cloth, with no emblem and no writing, only a subtle abstract scale pattern in silver thread, is planted on the broken top of a rampart and streams in the wind toward the camera. Light spreads from it in a ripple across the rows of anonymous armoured silhouettes below on the slope, each one straightening and raising a shield. A single plate-armoured standard-bearer is a small dark shape at its foot.
entries.accent: deep royal purple with pale silver dawn light
